sentences.section: The modified-unitarity ansatz and its one parameter
sentences.quote:
Equation~\eqref{eq:modified-unitarity} is an ansatz, and the formal
layer treats it as one. \texttt{WKBConnection.ModifiedBogoliubov} is a
structure whose fields are $|\alpha|^2 \geq 0$, $|\beta|^2 \geq 0$ and
Eq.~\eqref{eq:modified-unitarity} itself; the theorems of the module are
consequences of inhabiting it.
sentences.quote_normalized: equation~ is an ansatz, and the formal layer treats it as one. wkbconnection.modifiedbogoliubov is a structure whose fields are $|\alpha|^2 \geq 0$, $|\beta|^2 \geq 0$ and eq.~ itself; the theorems of the module are consequences of inhabiting it.
sentences.agent_notes: Conditional carrier; the law is an input field. Scope is a Lean structure, not a theorem deriving modified unitarity.

sentences.quote:
This is \texttt{WKBConnection.noiseFloor} with
\texttt{noise\_floor\_eq\_delta\_diss}; non-negativity is
\texttt{noise\_floor\_nonneg} and vanishing exactly at zero damping is
\texttt{noise\_floor\_zero\_iff}. Both are unfoldings of the definition
$n_{\rm noise} := \delta_k/2$, so what Eq.~\eqref{eq:noise-floor}
contributes is not a proof but a bookkeeping identity: the same number
that measures the unitarity deficit, divided by two, is the floor. Its
force comes from Eq.~\eqref{eq:cgl-fdr}, and it is exactly as
conditional as that relation.
sentences.quote_normalized: this is wkbconnection.noisefloor with noise\_floor\_eq\_delta\_diss; non-negativity is noise\_floor\_nonneg and vanishing exactly at zero damping is noise\_floor\_zero\_iff. both are unfoldings of the definition $n_{\rm noise} := \delta_k/2$, so what eq.~ contributes is not a proof but a bookkeeping identity: the same number that measures the unitarity deficit, divided by two, is the floor. its force comes from eq.~, and it is exactly as conditional as that relation.
sentences.agent_notes: Defined scalar floor and its elementary properties. Physical FDR is an input.

sentences.quote:
The corresponding inequality is
\texttt{WKBConnection.noise\_dominates\_when\_beta\_small}, which states
that $|\beta|^2 < n_{\rm noise}(1-\delta_k)$ implies
$n_{\rm Hawking} < n_{\rm noise}$; as a formal statement it is the
rearrangement of a quotient inequality, and the content of
Eq.~\eqref{eq:crossover} is arithmetic performed here.
sentences.quote_normalized: the corresponding inequality is wkbconnection.noise\_dominates\_when\_beta\_small, which states that $|\beta|^2 < n_{\rm noise}(1-\delta_k)$ implies $n_{\rm hawking} < n_{\rm noise}$; as a formal statement it is the rearrangement of a quotient inequality, and the content of eq.~ is arithmetic performed here.
sentences.agent_notes: Conditional quotient inequality with delta_k < 1 and supplied beta bound. The physical spectral crossover is not a Lean consequence of this statement.

sentences.section: Attenuation, and where the model provably fails
sentences.quote:
Assuming unit greybody factor,
$\Gamma(\omega) = 1$, the condition $G > 1/2$ reads
$\exp(2\pi\omega/\kappa_{\rm eff}) < 3$, that is
$\omega/\kappa_{\rm eff} < \ln 3/(2\pi) \approx 0.175$. That threshold
holds only under the unit-greybody model, not a measured transmission
profile.
sentences.quote_normalized: assuming unit greybody factor, $\gamma(\omega) = 1$, the condition $g > 1/2$ reads $\exp(2\pi\omega/\kappa_{\rm eff}) < 3$, that is $\omega/\kappa_{\rm eff} < \ln 3/(2\pi) \approx 0.175$. that threshold holds only under the unit-greybody model, not a measured transmission profile.
sentences.agent_notes: Unit-greybody adopted gain; log(3)/(2*pi)=0.17484957628 (0.08603 percent from printed 0.175). At the boundary G=0.5. No calibrated detection.

sentences.section: Attenuation, and where the model provably fails
sentences.quote:
For shot-noise-limited detection of a probe
carrying $N_{\rm probe}$ photons per mode, a single-shot
signal-to-noise ratio $\sqrt{N_{\rm probe}}\,G = 5$ needs
$N_{\rm probe} = 25/G^2$, of order $10^2$ photons per mode at
$G = 1/2$ in this ideal readout model.
sentences.quote_normalized: for shot-noise-limited detection of a probe carrying $n_{\rm probe}$ photons per mode, a single-shot signal-to-noise ratio $\sqrt{n_{\rm probe}}\,g = 5$ needs $n_{\rm probe} = 25/g^2$, of order $10^2$ photons per mode at $g = 1/2$ in this ideal readout model.
sentences.agent_notes: Ideal single-shot model: G=0.5 and N=100 give SNR=5. The theorem is sufficient for a supplied positive gain; it is not a physical device threshold.

sentences.section: The 2+1D acoustic metric and the quasi-one-dimensional reduction
sentences.quote:
Of the \reusePopulation{} theorems in the modules constituting
the one-dimensional treatment, \reuseTransferred{} are stated
parametrically in $c_s$ and transfer under $c_s \to v_F/\sqrt{2}$ with no
change of statement or proof, the remainder being condensate-specific;
the substantive content of that transfer is carried by the named theorems
quoted here, not by the fraction.
sentences.quote_normalized: of the \reusepopulation{} theorems in the modules constituting the one-dimensional treatment, \reusetransferred{} are stated parametrically in $c_s$ and transfer under $c_s \to v_f/\sqrt{2}$ with no change of statement or proof, the remainder being condensate-specific; the substantive content of that transfer is carried by the named theorems quoted here, not by the fraction.
sentences.agent_notes: Deterministic count_theorem_reuse.classify gives 107/120=89.17%, 13 platform-specific. Machine ownership is docs/counts.tex via update_counts.py; no graph link kind for this census script, and the count does not certify physical transfer.

The map performing the binding is
\texttt{DiracFluidWKB.toExactWKB}, which sends the graphene parameters to
the platform-independent parameter record of Sec.~\ref{sec:wkb} with
$c_s = v_F/\sqrt{2}$.
